g.text: Each cell on its own x axis. Realtime: time with at least one task of the step executing, queue waiting excluded
(parallel tasks counted once; pooled rows summed). Peak RAM: largest single task
One point per Nextflow process; point area = CPU cores used by its busiest task; colour = pipeline stage (Fig. 2a)
